items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Captain was the first one I ever heard play a take solos... I got a record with him playing mandolin

ctx.x: Well uh, I can remember Johnny Sincere, and uh, a boy named Cap, he was a bright boy, he played with uh, used to play with uh, Manuel Minera, not Manuel, Manuel Perez. Yeah, Capri Dairnsberg.
